SELECT l.*, u.user_name AS operatorUserName FROM audit_log l LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id=l.operator_user_id
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operatorUserName}, '%')
AND l.operate_module LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operateModule}, '%')
AND l.operate_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operateType}, '%')
ORDER BY l.log_id ASC
